## Target branch

Contributor PRs must target **develop**. Only this repository's **develop → master** promotion may target master. Required checks must pass before merging. Contributor PRs require @kcdriod approval; that owner account has a review-only exception for merging passing PRs, including its own.

## What changes?

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

Describe tests or manual checks. Add screenshots for UI changes, with personal information removed.

## Notes

Mention any important limitations, new external sources, or follow-up work.
